summary: One source row: its number, what it is, and the passage it supports.

useInstead.when: it is the inline marker in the prose

children.note: the quoted or summarised passage this source supports

guarantees: the visible number is `aria-hidden`; the row is named by its source text, which is what a reader needs to hear
without `href` the source renders as text rather than a dead link

antiPatterns.why: a screen reader spells it out character by character, and it names nothing
